title: 4UR4 Real-Market Fixture — expected-causal.json (SPR-D-01 Half B)
description: Machine-validated shape for the AS-OF-TIME (Half B) expectation of a real-market fixture. This is TEST DATA / RESEARCH EVIDENCE under the GOV-015 build-freeze, not product implementation. It is deliberately a SEPARATE document from fixture.schema.json: the golden schema requires a GX-\d\d id and a full transition list, and admitting a real fixture into it would have meant WEAKENING the golden gate (relaxing the id pattern and demoting required fields). A new document type is the smaller, purely additive change. Per SPR-D-01 Limit 1, the asserted surface is Phase-2-owned behaviour ONLY: the formation trace, the as-of-time selection over the bars strictly before the stop, and line_at_stop. It asserts NO frozen line, NO BROKEN_OUT state and NO BREAKOUT_CONFIRMED reason code — those are Phase 3's. Per SPR-D-01 Limit 3, if the values here were generated by tools/fixture-replay.mjs they are MODEL-DERIVED and this document is a regression guard against today's reference model, NOT an independent correctness check; `provenance` must therefore state that on the artifact's face.

fixture_id.description: Real-market fixture identifier, e.g. RM-01. Distinct namespace from the golden GX-\d\d ids.

layer.description: Names which of RM-01's two records this file is. Half A (the full-series geometry) lives in annotation.json and is NOT restated here; neither layer supersedes the other (SPR-D-01).

purpose.description: One-sentence statement of what this document locks.

spec_refs.description: Spec sections and decisions relied on, e.g. ['§21.5','HD-12','SPR-D-01'].

provenance.description: SPR-D-01 Limit 3 requires the Half B artifact to state its own provenance ON ITS FACE, not only in the register.

generated_by.description: The tool that produced these values, e.g. 'tools/fixture-replay.mjs' — the HD-15-permitted causal reference model.

derivation.description: MUST be 'model-derived'. These values come from the reference model, not from an independent human re-derivation. Stating anything else would overclaim exactly as SPR-D-01 Limit 3 forbids.

is_independent_verification.description: MUST be false. RM-01's non-circularity attaches to Half A's human-approved geometry and to the real, undesigned prices — never to Half B's provenance.

guard_kind.description: What this document actually is. It detects drift from today's model; it cannot detect that today's model is wrong.

author_independence.description: HD-15 condition 2 / E2-AUTHOR attestation: who authored this file, that the author READ tools/fixture-replay.mjs and is therefore DISQUALIFIED from authoring the Phase 2 engine, and that the Phase 2 engine author must be a different agent that has read neither this file nor the reference model.

assertable_surface.description: SPR-D-01 Limit 2: Half B NARROWS RM-01's Phase-2 assertable surface. Stating the surface explicitly is what stops a later reader from re-expanding it.

bars_to.description: Inclusive last bar whose as-of-time selection is asserted. Must be stop_index - 1.

plus_stop_index.description: Correct identification of the stop index is asserted in addition to bars_from..bars_to.

not_asserted.description: The explicit exclusion list. A gate that only says what it checks silently grows; this says what it deliberately does not.

fields.description: Must include the frozen line, the final state, and the BREAKOUT_CONFIRMED reason code (SPR-D-01 Limit 1).

params.description: The ratified HD-14 / D-TL-12 parameter set used to derive every value below.

eps_break_locked.description: MUST be false — eps_break is versioned and backtestable, never locked.

input_binding.description: Ties this expectation to the exact committed bytes it was derived from, so a silent input edit cannot leave a passing gate. It is the ONLY check covering bars AFTER the stop index, which no asserted value touches — moving a post-stop close to anywhere within its own [low, high] changes nothing else in this document. (Note the example must stay COHERENT: halving a close usually drives it below the bar's low, which trips the §18 INVALID_INPUT guard and is therefore highly visible. The invisible edits are the OHLC-coherent ones.) `required` here as well as at the root: without it `"input_binding": {}` satisfied the schema and only the harness objected.

t_form.description: First bar at which a line is ACTIVE.

reason.description: Why the line is not yet ACTIVE at t; null once it is eligible.

as_of_time_selection.description: Per-bar as-of-time state for every bar in the assertable surface. Each entry is derived ONLY from bars strictly earlier than the bar it judges (§21 / HD-12 / D-TL-11).

no_line_reason.description: Set when no line is active at t, e.g. INSUFFICIENT_BARS.

reselections.description: Pre-stop re-selections of B* (§21.6), each recorded with the bar it takes effect on.

line_at_stop.description: The line ACTIVE AT the stop bar — explicitly NOT the frozen line Λ^F (SPR-D-01 Limit 1).

stop_index.description: The bar at which Phase-2-assertable behaviour stops.

stop_index_is_engine_derived.description: SPR-D-01 Limit 1b: the stop index MUST be derived by the engine, never supplied to it by the fixture or the harness. A harness that hands over the stop index makes the B-clause assert nothing about the engine's own detection.

close_vs_line_log.description: ln(close) − y_hat — the RAW clearance, tolerance-GROSS. This is the quantity SPR-D-01, roadmap.md and fixtures/README.md all call 'the margin' (0.0864461 for RM-01), and it is the one the 'suppression needs eps_break ≥ margin' statement refers to.

close_vs_line_plus_eps_break_log.description: ln(close) − (y_hat + eps_break) — the tolerance-NET excess. This is the quantity tools/fixture-replay.mjs stores in its own events[].margin field (0.0764461 for RM-01). Recorded under a distinct name because the two differ by exactly eps_break and an unqualified 'margin' has two readings.

robustness.description: HD-13 requires ordinary fixtures to be tolerance-robust. Sweeps are recorded so a fragile expectation cannot pass unnoticed.

non_endorsement.description: SPR-D-01's mandatory non-endorsement clause, required to appear ON THE ARTIFACT and not only in the register: this is an evidentiary conformance expectation, not an economic endorsement.

geometry_check.description: Restated arithmetic so an independent verifier can confirm every number by hand.
